4460-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1021-5478-6303-6620.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving a creature shroud until end of turn.
Repeat.
1021-5478-6303-6620.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

345-5641-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2457-2757.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3756-4913-5310-7857.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

1879-2034-3755-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1308-4636-5770-7824.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

2279-3240-6462-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2523-2869-6296.description:
Activate Jirina by sacrificing it.
When Jirina dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Jirina that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Jirina ability.
Repeat using the Jirina token

2450-4050-6747-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
2450-4050-6747-7639.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Sami.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1494-2100-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-2100-4613-7152.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-2100-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Searing Touch. Searing Touch is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7159.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1621-2441-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Rasputin and Wispweaver Angel.
Cast Rasputin from exile by paying {2}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Activate Rasputin's first ability seven times by removing seven dream counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {2}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

851-4136-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-4136-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2692-2841-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2692-2841-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

373-877-6845.description:
Cast Spider-Byte by paying {0}.
When Spider-Byte enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1414-2854-4574-5243.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-2854-4574-5243.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

5670-6291-6559.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6291-6559.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

645-1267-2438-3908.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2438-3908.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

2232-5636-5659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf.
You have at least one nonartifact Lhurgoyf creature card in hand.
2232-5636-5659.description:
Activate Psychic Frog's first ability by discarding a nonartifact Lhurgoyf card.
Disa the Restless' first ability triggers, putting the discarded Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1393-2438-4986-5034--18.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Aether Channeler, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=1 by paying at most {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Aether Channeler, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2281-2438-4549-5006.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

386-3263-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Glistening Oil, adding {2}.
Glistening Oil's second ability triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Glistening Oil by paying {2}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat.

286-2440-2634.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Orc and/or Shaman.
286-2440-2634.description:
Cast Rishkar's Expertise by paying {4}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Rishkar's Expertise.
Resolve the copy of Rishkar's Expertise, causing you to draw cards equal to the greatest power among creatures you control and casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
When Rootha enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Orc and/or Shaman you control.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control two other Orcs and/or Shamans, this combo nets near-infinite colorless mana.

1965-2500-4547-4600.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
1965-2500-4547-4600.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
Omarthis's first triggered ability triggers.
In response, activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Omarthis until end of turn.
Resolve the Omarthis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Mirage Mirror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 5 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to place a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Warning: Omarthis's last ability can increase the risk of losing by drawing from an empty library if you place enough counters on them.

2023-4050-4770-4772.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Aragorn's first ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Human Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

2034-3517-4186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Scurry Oak has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3517-4186.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Tainted Observer triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

474-1810-2034.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Specimen Collector.
The Specimen Collector token enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Specimen Collector, adding {C}{C}.
Specimen Collector dies, creating a token copy of the Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 2.

1110-1744.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Terror of the Peaks.
The five Terror of the Peaks tokens enter the battlefield, triggering the nontoken Terror of the Peaks five times and each Terror of the Peaks token four times.
Resolve all Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 125 damage divided among a maximum of 25 targets.

190-1321-4531.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Cast Morningtide by paying {1}{W}, exiling all cards from all graveyards.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.

391-3525-3756.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-3525-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.

757-943-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, choose not to pay.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on it and causing you to skip your next turn.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magosi's ability.
Resolve both Magosi abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your first extra turn, which is skipped due to Magosi's ability which resolved in step 3.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.
